# CANDIDATE: LATE_DAY_VWAP_RSI_EXTREME_REVERSION

**Filed:** 2026-07-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

After lunch, extreme RSI readings (>70 or <30) combined with a flat EMA ribbon (EMA8-EMA21 within ±0.1%) and a significant deviation from VWAP (>0.6%) precede mean‑reversion to VWAP as liquidity providers step in. The edge exists because the market is temporarily exhausted and institutional liquidity returns to pull price back toward the volume‑weighted average price.

## Mechanism

**Entry:** After 13:30 EST, if |close‑VWAP|/VWAP > 0.006 AND RSI(14) > 70 AND EMA8‑EMA21 between ‑0.1% and +0.1% → enter short; if RSI < 30 with same flat ribbon → enter long.  
**Exit:** Chart‑stop at the recent swing point (structure invalidation), TP1 at VWAP, runner trail 8% off high‑water mark. Avoid first and last 15 minutes of the session; only active when VIX < 25 and ADX < 20.
